cases.name: 64K/Chinese/paragraph/LF64
cases.pattern: 本文介绍 Markdown 解析器的实现。扫描器需要正确处理中文、标点与换行。上线之前应检查性能，不同输入的结果都应保持一致。

method: A=Index0, B=current Latin1. Same BlockLines API and capacity preparation; only scanner routing differs. Reused line table and Latin1 scratch buffer; Latin1 copy included. 8 consecutive lengths per synthetic case, one full document per real corpus. Full row/normalization oracle before timing. 100ms warmup, GC, 50ms settling, 200ms natural-GC timing per case. Four ABBA/BAAB blocks in each of forward and reversed case orders, one fresh process per observation. ns is per document, not per group of eight. No production-source changes.
